unit: one (arm, N) cell, compared with the same arm's fresh N=1 control in the same blocks
block_order: randomized with seed 20261101; every block runs all four arms at one N at once
accepted_point: task landed on integration main AND its hidden check green on the final integrated tree at drain

metrics.accepted_per_hour: accepted points / hours from first dispatch to drain or cutoff, waits NOT subtracted
metrics.cost_per_point: reconciled account-total spend for the run / accepted points

escalate_to_next_N_when_all.upper_bound_method: worst block's paired drop over the same tasks

otherwise: hold: report this N as the measured setting; do not escalate
ceiling_claim: only when N passes the escalate test and the next N fails it; reaching N=4 green states 'no ceiling found up to 4', never a ceiling
throughput_cost_tradeoff: the cost ratio bound is the tradeoff; the owner may change any threshold before launch only, which changes this file's sha256 and must be re-recorded in the ledger
